_comment: Fab OS administrator policy. Copy to /etc/fabos/policy.json (root:root 0644). Absent file = no restriction. Every key is optional; unknown keys are reported in `fabos policy`. Reload with `systemctl --user kill -s HUP fabos-agent` (per user) or `fabos policy --reload`; a reboot or relogin also reloads. See docs/ENTERPRISE.md.
